LAWS (CONTINUANCE IN FORCE)
(NINTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th June 1979]
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that behalf, the Chief
Martial Law Administrator is pleased to make the following Order :-
1.-(1)
This Order may be called the Laws (Continuance in Force) (Ninth Amendment)
Order, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
2.
In the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. 1 of
1977), in Article 2, in clause (1), in the Explanation after the words
"amending it" at the end the commas, words, brackets and .figures,
"except the Constitution (First Amendment) Act, 1974 (XXXIII of
1974)" shall be added and shall be deemed always to have been so added.
MARTIAL LAW REGULATION
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW
ADMINISTRATOR
No. 46
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 10th June 1979]
In Martial Law Regulation No. 21, in paragraph 7, after
the words, "Chief Martial Law Administrator", the words "or a
Martial Law Adminis trator" shall be inserted and shall be deemed to have
always been so inserted.
